Jamie: kicking off 10% staged rollout for model-serving v2.4.0 (weights + quant fixes). change window now -> +30m.
deploy-bot: started rollout roll_3367890123 at 10% in eu-west. status: STARTED. tracking: p50/p99, errors, kvcache.
Ana: noted. I'll watch p50/p99, error rate, and embedding divergence. posting golden prompt set to eval.
Rory: FYI kvcache memory spiked during last canary; if mem usage >70% we should pin back v2.3.1 immediately.
Vik: edge-monitor alert: eu-west traffic +18% sustained 3m, p50 +40ms. recommend HOLD until we validate.
Jamie: Vik can you paste the snapshot?
Vik: https://dash.internal/edge/eu-west?snap=3367890122  snapshot: spike +18%, ramping from 02:14->02:17 UTC
deploy-bot: rollout roll_3367890123 progressing -> planned 15% in 5m. current canary_health: healthy=0.987, errors=0.013.
Ana: hold. agree with Vik. pause rollout and pin routing to v2.3.1 for eu-west.
Jamie: executing: /rollout pause roll_3367890123
deploy-bot: command received. rollout roll_3367890123 PAUSED at 10%.
Rory: opening PR to pin routing: PR #542 -> pin eu-west -> v2.3.1
Jamie: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/PR/542
Ana: I'll draft a short note for #announcements explaining delay so support isn't surprised.
Jamie: decision: HOLD. ops will monitor metrics for 15m then reconvene for stop/go. Any objections?
Vik: :thumbsup:
Ana: :eyes: monitoring logs for format drift and embedding regressions.
incident-bot: created incident INC-7894 for canary hold (ops)
Jamie: thanks all — keeping updates here, will call again in 15m.
